Introduction

AM8IC is an upcoming boy group under TOV Entertainment. They are set to debut in November 2025 with their first EP, Lukoie. The group’s name combines “Ambi-,” meaning two-way, and “Connect,” symbolizing connection. It represents the idea of “lost boys” moving toward growth and salvation through genuine bonds with one another. On August 31, 2025, TOV Entertainment unveiled a logo motion for AM8IC and launched the group’s official social media accounts. The following day, the agency announced that the group would debut in the second half of the year. Member reveals began on September 1, 2025, starting with Saho, followed by Mingkai on September 2, Chungyi on September 3, Roux on September 4, and Chen on September 5. On September 8, 2025, it was officially confirmed that AM8IC would make their debut in November with the EP Lukoie.
